changes: Centralized CSRF helper retained in both frontend roots.
State-changing authenticated requests use the CSRF-aware fetch helper.
Logout handlers call the backend logout endpoint before returning to the login page.
Invitation tokens are kept in memory and removed from the URL immediately after parsing.
Frontend API base URLs use same-origin /api paths instead of hard-coded localhost URLs.
Admin UI access remains backend-authorized; the privileged admin assets are server-gated.
Dynamic backend-provided HTML in reporting/visualization/profile views is escaped or URL-validated.
The backend remains authoritative for authentication and authorization.
remaining_direct_state_changing_fetches: login is intentionally CSRF-exempt because it establishes the authentication session.
